prompt: Claire's younger brother ___ to bed while the guests were still talking in the living room.
explanation_ru: Действие происходило в процессе в момент речи гостей (while... were talking), а брат является объектом действия — нужен Past Continuous Passive: was being put.

prompt: I am delighted because I (to promote) to team leader after my recent presentation.
explanation_ru: Радость в настоящем связана с совершившимся повышением, поэтому используется Present Perfect Passive: have been promoted.

prompt: When I reached the university archive, all the rare manuscripts (to lock) inside a climate-controlled vault.
explanation_ru: Рукописи убрали в хранилище раньше момента в прошлом (reached), поэтому нужен Past Perfect Passive: had been locked.

prompt: Good news for your neighbourhood: a bright new community centre will be build near the square.
answer: Good news for your neighbourhood: a bright new community centre will be built near the square.
accepted_answers: Good news for your neighbourhood: a bright new community centre will be built near the square.
explanation_ru: В пассивном залоге после will be требуется третья форма неправильного глагола build — built, а не build.

prompt: Science experiments are an important part of the weekly timetable. Safety goggles (to wear) by all students during every chemistry lab. During the last lesson, a new heating method (to demonstrate) when the bell suddenly rang.
explanation_ru: Постоянное правило лаборатории передаётся через Present Simple Passive (are worn), а процесс, прерванный звонком в прошлом (rang), — через Past Continuous Passive (was being demonstrated).

prompt: Almond croissants (not / to bake) on site; a local bakery delivers them fresh each morning.
explanation_ru: Речь о постоянном порядке работы кофейни, поэтому используется отрицание в Present Simple Passive: are not baked.

prompt: Welcome to the Harbour View Hotel! Before your arrival, every balcony window (to polish) until it shone. At the moment, fresh towels (to place) in the spa suites for the afternoon session. By sunset, welcome baskets (to deliver) to every guest room.
explanation_ru: Действие до приезда в прошлом требует Past Perfect Passive (had been polished), текущий процесс (At the moment) — Present Continuous Passive (are being placed), а завершение к будущему моменту (By sunset) — Future Perfect Passive (will have been delivered).

prompt: Heavy fog rolled across the valley, so several mountain hikers (to rescue) by local volunteers.
explanation_ru: Повествование идёт в прошедшем времени (rolled), поэтому для множественного числа hikers нужен Past Simple Passive: were rescued.

prompt: By the time we return from our autumn holiday, all the broken pavements along Oak Street (to repave).
explanation_ru: Конструкция By the time + Present Simple указывает на действие, которое завершится до будущего момента: will have been repaved.

prompt: Look near the fruit counter: fresh organic strawberries (to unpack) by the shop assistants.
explanation_ru: Призыв Look показывает, что действие происходит прямо сейчас, поэтому нужен Present Continuous Passive: are being unpacked.

prompt: The bank manager confirmed that the suspicious transfer ___ before the customer even noticed the missing money.
explanation_ru: Блокировка перевода произошла ещё до того, как клиент заметил пропажу в прошлом (noticed), поэтому нужен Past Perfect Passive: had been blocked.

prompt: Have you (to contact) by the station office about the leather wallet you left behind?
explanation_ru: В вопросе Present Perfect Passive после Have и подлежащего ставится been + третья форма глагола: been contacted.

prompt: Notice to residents: any bicycles left in the hallway (to remove) without further warning.
explanation_ru: Официальное предупреждение о будущих мерах выражается через Future Simple Passive: will be removed.

prompt: By the time I wake up tomorrow morning, all my photos ___ automatically to the new cloud drive.
explanation_ru: Загрузка завершится к конкретному моменту в будущем (By the time I wake up tomorrow morning) — нужен Future Perfect Passive: will have been uploaded.

prompt: Alice had strong qualifications, yet she (not / to invite) to the second round of interviews.
explanation_ru: Контекст относится к прошедшему отбору (had), поэтому отрицание строится в Past Simple Passive: was not invited.

prompt: Two injured players (to examine) by the team doctor while the referee spoke with both captains.
explanation_ru: Союз while вводит длительный процесс в прошлом, параллельный разговору судьи (spoke), поэтому нужен Past Continuous Passive: were being examined.

prompt: Chopped herbs (to sprinkle) over the roasted vegetables just before the dish goes onto the table.
explanation_ru: Рецепт описывает регулярную последовательность приготовления, поэтому используется Present Simple Passive: are sprinkled.

prompt: Our original coach broke down, so we (to transfer) to a comfortable express train instead.
explanation_ru: Последовательность событий в прошлом (broke down) требует Past Simple Passive: were transferred.

prompt: The boxes are unpacked, though the living room curtains (not / to hang) yet.
explanation_ru: Слово yet в отрицании указывает на отсутствие результата к настоящему моменту — Present Perfect Passive: have not been hung.

prompt: Water leaked into our hallway, and we ___ about the pipe repair until the ceiling turned wet.
explanation_ru: Ситуация в прошлом (leaked, turned), для местоимения we нужен глагол were и третья форма warn: were not warned.

prompt: By the time you finish your coffee, your updated account settings will have been save across all devices.
answer: By the time you finish your coffee, your updated account settings will have been saved across all devices.
accepted_answers: By the time you finish your coffee, your updated account settings will have been saved across all devices.
explanation_ru: В конструкции Future Perfect Passive после will have been нужна третья форма глагола (V3): saved, а не save.

prompt: Mobile phones must stay silent because every performance (to record) live for an online broadcast.
explanation_ru: Речь о постоянном правиле на каждом спектакле, поэтому нужен Present Simple Passive: is recorded.

prompt: We are sitting on the plane while our suitcases ___ into the cargo hold below.
explanation_ru: Чемоданы загружают прямо сейчас (are sitting... while), поэтому для множественного числа нужен Present Continuous Passive: are being loaded.

prompt: Will you (to accompany) by two teachers during the museum tour tomorrow afternoon?
explanation_ru: В вопросе Future Simple Passive после Will и подлежащего ставится be + третья форма глагола: be accompanied.

prompt: Grace was relieved when the courier finally knocked on her front door. Her birthday parcel (to misplace) at the regional sorting hub before a clerk spotted the torn label. Since then, the damaged box (to repack) carefully in sturdy cardboard. By tonight, a confirmation receipt (to email) to the sender as well.
explanation_ru: Ошибка произошла до того, как её заметил сотрудник в прошлом (had been misplaced), переупаковка уже выполнена к настоящему моменту (has been repacked), а квитанция будет отправлена к вечеру (By tonight → will have been emailed).

prompt: All museum passes ___ in the basic tour price, so visitors pay separately at the gate.
explanation_ru: Passes — множественное число, и нужна третья форма глагола include: are not included.

prompt: The police ___ after several customers paid for concert tickets on a fake website.
explanation_ru: Существительное police в английском всегда согласуется с глаголом множественного числа, поэтому в Past Simple Passive нужно were called.

prompt: Good news from the dean's office: the housing news ___ with all exchange students.
explanation_ru: Слово news в английском всегда в единственном числе, поэтому в Present Perfect Passive требуется has been shared.

prompt: Why was I (not / to advise) to take these tablets after a meal?
explanation_ru: В отрицательном вопросе Past Simple Passive после was I ставится not + третья форма глагола: not advised.

prompt: The backyard looks wonderful after a busy weekend of work. A smooth stone path (to lay) between the terrace and the greenhouse. Next spring, climbing roses (to plant) along the wooden fence.
explanation_ru: Видимый результат в настоящем передаётся через Present Perfect Passive (has been laid), а план на будущий сезон (Next spring) — через Future Simple Passive (will be planted).

prompt: Our indoor pool is closed for maintenance today. The old tiles around the deep end (to replace) by a specialist crew. Training sessions (to hold) at the neighbouring leisure centre until Friday.
explanation_ru: Ремонт идёт сейчас (today → are being replaced), а временное расписание занятий до пятницы выражается через Future Simple Passive (will be held).

prompt: Hey Toby, sorry I am late — my train ___ yet because of a signal fault.
explanation_ru: Слово yet в отрицании требует Present Perfect Passive; для train в единственном числе правильно has not been cleared.

prompt: Our outdoor garden party ran into sudden trouble. While the paper lanterns (to hang) between the trees, a heavy rainstorm started. All the snacks (to move) quickly into the kitchen, so nothing got soaked.
explanation_ru: While вводит длительное действие в прошлом (were being hung), а последовавшее действие в рассказе передаётся через Past Simple Passive (were moved).

prompt: Several regular diners complained because their corner table (not / to reserve) despite their phone call earlier that afternoon.
explanation_ru: Бронь не оформили ещё до прихода гостей и их жалобы в прошлом (complained), поэтому нужен Past Perfect Passive: had not been reserved.

prompt: We have been given front-row passes for the charity concert by the festival organisers.
answer: We have been given front-row passes for the charity concert by the festival organisers.
accepted_answers: We have been given front-row passes for the charity concert by the festival organisers.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: форма Present Perfect Passive (have been given) употреблена верно.

prompt: Had your car (already / to tow) away when you came back to the parking meter?
explanation_ru: Вопрос касается действия, которое могло произойти до возвращения к машине в прошлом (came back), поэтому используется Past Perfect Passive: already been towed.

prompt: Please use the side mirror because the main fitting room is painting right now.
answer: Please use the side mirror because the main fitting room is being painted right now.
accepted_answers: Please use the side mirror because the main fitting room is being painted right now.
explanation_ru: Примерочная не красит сама себя — её красят прямо сейчас, поэтому нужен Present Continuous Passive: is being painted.
